steps: 1. Equip an identifiable native weapon pair before entering the Pilgrimage Chamber. Record both durable pre-run identities, complete a solo expedition, and inspect both slots on return to the chamber and then the Keep before equipping anything else.
2. Repeat with a supported public Weapon Tweaker cross-character weapon. Record the exact ported identity, not just its weapon type, and inspect both return boundaries.

3. During native and WT runs, obtain an available Chaos Wastes upgrade/replacement and record its temporary identity separately from the pre-run durable item. Confirm returning home restores the exact durable identities rather than persisting a temporary upgrade or falling back to an older/base weapon.
4. Exercise both weapon slots across the runs. Report any upgrade or slot cell you could not exercise; it is not a pass.
assertions: Native and public-WT durable weapon identities survive the full expedition and both return boundaries. Temporary Chaos Wastes upgrades do not overwrite the durable items, and neither slot falls back to a base/older identity or emits a resolution error.
Under mechanism deus call BackendUtils.set_loadout_item with a run-local backend id; assert the GUT durable row is unchanged and post-run loadout ids equal the pre-run snapshot.
